openwrt_wiki_rb941.Titel: MikroTik RouterBoard RB941-2nD / RB941-2nD-TC (hAP lite) / RB951Ui-2nD (Full hAP)
openwrt_wiki_rb941.Hinweis: Since the Full hAP (RB951Ui-2nD) is very similar to it younger brother, the description of it is also located here. The hEX lite (RB750-r2) is very similar to RB951Ui-2nD and has its own page.
openwrt_wiki_rb941.Installation: Caveats highlighted in Common Procedures for Mikrotik RouterBoard Products apply. Version 19.07.10 is too big for install and upgrade. I install 18.06.9 first in RAM and then upgrade to 19.07.10. (ar71xx-Zeit)
openwrt_wiki_rb941.Supported devices (ar71xx rb-nor-flash-1: rb-750-r2 rb-750up-r2 rb-750p-pbr2 rb-911-2hn rb-911-5hn rb-941-2nd rb-951ui-2nd rb-952ui-5ac2nd rb-962uigs-5hact2hnt rb-lhg-5nd rb-map-2nd rb-mapl-2nd rb-wap-2nd
openwrt_wiki_rb941.How to enable Serial Port (gekuerzt): There is (unsoldered) serial port on the board, which can be used with 3.3V TTL converter. Port settings are 115200/8N1. However, by default serial port is not enabled (there is no data on it). Aktivierung ueber Aenderung der hard_config-Partition beschrieben, nur mit RouterBOOT 3.27 oder aelter (Schritte hier nicht uebernommen).
openwrt_wiki_rb941.Backup-Bootloader: There are 2 bootloaders in the board: routerboot2 (main loader) and routerboot (backup loader). To force boot from the backup loader turn device on with button pressed and wait ~30 seconds.
openwrt_wiki_rb941.Bootlog: RouterOS-Bootlog mit board=H951L, mem=32M - gehoert zum hAP lite, nicht zum RB951Ui-2nD

openwrt_git_ath79.Titel: ath79: add support for MikroTik hAP (RB951Ui-2nD)
openwrt_git_ath79.Beschreibung: The MikroTik hAP (product code RB951Ui-2nD) is an indoor 2.4Ghz AP with a 2 dBi integrated antenna built around the Atheros QCA9531 SoC.
Specifications: Ethernet: Atheros AR934X switch, 5x 10/100 ports, 10-28 V passive PoE in port 1, 500 mA PoE out on port 5
8 user-controllable LEDs: 1x power (green), 1x user (green), 4x LAN status (green), 1x WAN status (green), 1x PoE power status (red)
openwrt_git_ath79.Notes: The device was already supported in the ar71xx target.
openwrt_git_ath79.Flashing: TFTP boot initramfs image and then perform sysupgrade. Follow common MikroTik procedure as in https://openwrt.org/toh/mikrotik/common.

Hinweise: PR-Titel nannte faelschlich hAP ac lite; joaochainho: 'this isn't the ac version, just hAP'
f00b4r0: 'the hAP doesn't have PCI / 5GHz wifi'; DTS nutzt dieselbe Basis wie hAP ac lite (qca9533_mikrotik_routerboard-95x.dtsi)
mkg20001: ath10k entfernt, WLAN funktioniert weiter; Probleme mit kmod-usb2 im initramfs ('Slim down your initramfs it'll boot')
Ethernet-MACs eth0/eth1 zufaellig, br-lan/wan-MACs aus board.json korrekt (akzeptierter Nebeneffekt)

mikrotik_produktseite.Untertitel: 2.4GHz AP, Five Ethernet ports, PoE-out on port 5, USB for 3G/4G support
mikrotik_produktseite.Beschreibung: This small home access point is the perfect device for homes or small offices where all you need is a wireless AP and a few wired devices connected. Based on our popular RB951-2n, the new hAP is an improvement in many areas. The device can be powered from the power jack or with passive PoE from a PoE injector. The power adapter is included. hAP provides PoE output function for port #5 - it can power other PoE capable devices with the same voltage as applied to the unit. Maximum load on the port is 500mA.

mikrotik_handbuch.Sicherheit: This product is intended to be installed indoors. Keep this product away from water, fire, humidity or hot environments. (Textbaustein nennt auch rackmount)
mikrotik_handbuch.Connecting: Connect your Internet cable to port 1, and local network PCs to ports 2-5. Default 192.168.88.1
mikrotik_handbuch.Powering: Direct-input power jack (5.5mm outside and 2mm inside, female, pin positive plug) accepts 10-28 V DC; The First Ethernet port accepts passive Power over Ethernet 10-28 V DC. The power consumption under maximum load can reach 5 W.
mikrotik_handbuch.Mounting: The device is designed to be used indoors, by placing it on the desktop. We recommend using Cat5 shielded cable. MPE minimum 20 cm.
mikrotik_handbuch.Extension slots and ports: Five individual 10/100 Ethernet ports, Auto MDI/X; One Integrated Wireless 2.4 GHz 802.11b/g/n, 2x2 MIMO with two onboard PIF antennas, max gain 1.5 dBi; One USB type-A slot; Ether5 PoE output approximately 2 V below input voltage, up to 0.58 A (24 V PSU -> 22 V/0.58 A), auto detection
mikrotik_handbuch.Reset button: 5 s: RouterOS-Konfiguration zuruecksetzen; 10 s: CAP-Modus; 15 s: Netinstall; vor dem Einschalten gedrueckt: Backup-RouterBOOT
mikrotik_handbuch.EAC: 2400-2483.5 MHz, <=100 mW; Herstellungsdatum am Ende der Seriennummer nach Schraegstrich (Jahr letzte Ziffer, dann Kalenderwoche)

mikrotik_broschuere.Gehaeuse: The device is very small and will look good in any home or office, wall mounting anchor holes are provided.
